summary: Eva Live Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to 4,576,272 common shares issuable upon conversion of a $2,160,000 secured convertible note sold to Streeterville Capital LLC for $2,000,000 gross proceeds. The offering is direct to the investor with no placement agent. The company is a controlled entity with CEO David Boulette holding 57.86% voting power. This is a routine capital-raising registration, not a special situation. No price per share, premium, or expected close are stated; the filing relates solely to the registration of conversion shares.
